queries.item: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:is2or_claid_images` ( `image_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `company_id` INT(11) UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `path` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `filesize` INT(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `timestamp` INT(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `is_tmp` TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', PRIMARY KEY(`image_id`) ) Engine=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET UTF8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:is2or_claid_credit_logs` ( `log_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `company_id` INT(11) UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `image_id` INT(11) UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `description` TEXT, `timestamp` INT(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `credits` INT(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', PRIMARY KEY(`log_id`) ) Engine=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET UTF8;
ALTER TABLE `?:companies` ADD `is2or_claid_credits` INT(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:is2or_product_garments ( `garment_id` INT(11) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `product_id` INT(11) UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `pair_id` INT(11) UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `position` INT(11) UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `status` CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'A', PRIMARY KEY(`garment_id`) ) Engine=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET UTF8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:is2or_tryon_models ( `model_id` INT(11) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `user_id` INT(11) UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `pair_id` INT(11) UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `status` CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'A', PRIMARY KEY(`model_id`) ) Engine=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET UTF8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:is2or_tryon_results ( `result_id` INT(11) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `user_id` INT(11) UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `model_id` INT(11) UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `garment_ids` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `product_id` INT(11) UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `path` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `timestamp` INT(11) UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', PRIMARY KEY(`result_id`) ) Engine=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET UTF8;
ALTER TABLE ?:categories ADD `is2or_tryon_enabled` CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'N';
